summary: Radarr is an automated media management tool designed to monitor, find, and retrieve movie files through Usenet and BitTorrent networks. Operating as a fork of Sonarr, it handles the lifecycle of movie collection by watching for new releases and organising existing directories. It functions as a background service that interacts with various download clients.
goodFor: It is well-suited for media enthusiasts who want to maintain an automated, self-hosted film library without manual searching and sorting.
watchOut: You will need to ensure compliance with local copyright regulations regarding automated downloading, and the software must be carefully secured if exposed to the internet.
deployNotes: Containerised deployments typically require persistent volume mounts for configuration files and media directories, alongside a reverse proxy if you require secure remote access.
